<?php
/**
 * Checklist item definitions and post type helpers.
 *
 * @package EditorialChecklist
 */

namespace EditorialChecklist;

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Default checklist items.
 *
 * @return array[] List of items with `id`, `label` and `required` keys.
 */
function get_default_items() {
	return array(
		array(
			'id'       => 'headline',
			'label'    => __( 'Headline has been proofread', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => true,
		),
		array(
			'id'       => 'featured-image',
			'label'    => __( 'Featured image is set and credited', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => true,
		),
		array(
			'id'       => 'links',
			'label'    => __( 'All links have been checked', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => true,
		),
		array(
			'id'       => 'categories',
			'label'    => __( 'Categories and tags are assigned', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => false,
		),
		array(
			'id'       => 'excerpt',
			'label'    => __( 'Excerpt has been written', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => false,
		),
	);
}

/**
 * Returns the filtered, normalized checklist items.
 *
 * Items with a missing/duplicate id or an empty label are dropped.
 *
 * @return array[] List of items with `id` (string), `label` (string) and `required` (bool).
 */
function get_items() {
	/**
	 * Filters the editorial checklist items.
	 *
	 * @param array[] $items Items, each an array with `id`, `label` and optional `required` keys.
	 */
	$items = apply_filters( 'editorial_checklist_items', get_default_items() );

	if ( ! is_array( $items ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$normalized = array();
	$seen       = array();

	foreach ( $items as $item ) {
		if ( ! is_array( $item ) || empty( $item['id'] ) || empty( $item['label'] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$id    = sanitize_key( (string) $item['id'] );
		$label = sanitize_text_field( (string) $item['label'] );

		if ( '' === $id || '' === $label || isset( $seen[ $id ] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$seen[ $id ]  = true;
		$normalized[] = array(
			'id'       => $id,
			'label'    => $label,
			'required' => ! empty( $item['required'] ),
		);
	}

	return $normalized;
}

/**
 * Post types the checklist is enabled for.
 *
 * Only post types that are shown in REST and support custom fields are kept,
 * because the block editor can only read/write meta for those.
 *
 * @return string[]
 */
function get_post_types() {
	/**
	 * Filters the post types that get the editorial checklist.
	 *
	 * @param string[] $post_types Post type slugs.
	 */
	$post_types = (array) apply_filters( 'editorial_checklist_post_types', array( 'post', 'page' ) );

	return array_values(
		array_filter(
			array_map( 'sanitize_key', $post_types ),
			static function ( $post_type ) {
				$object = get_post_type_object( $post_type );

				return $object
					&& ! empty( $object->show_in_rest )
					&& post_type_supports( $post_type, 'custom-fields' );
			}
		)
	);
}

<?php
/**
 * Post meta registration.
 *
 * @package EditorialChecklist
 */

namespace EditorialChecklist;

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Registers the `_editorial_checklist` post meta for each enabled post type.
 *
 * The value is an array of the ids of completed checklist items.
 *
 * Runs late on `init` so post types registered by other code are available.
 */
function register_meta() {
	foreach ( get_post_types() as $post_type ) {
		register_post_meta(
			$post_type,
			EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_META_KEY,
			array(
				'type'              => 'array',
				'description'       => __( 'IDs of completed editorial checklist items.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
				'single'            => true,
				'default'           => array(),
				'sanitize_callback' => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\sanitize_meta',
				'auth_callback'     => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\auth_meta',
				'show_in_rest'      => array(
					'schema' => array(
						'type'  => 'array',
						'items' => array(
							'type'    => 'string',
							'pattern' => '^[a-z0-9_\-]+$',
						),
					),
				),
			)
		);
	}
}
add_action( 'init', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\register_meta', 99 );

/**
 * Sanitizes the meta value into a unique list of item ids.
 *
 * @param mixed $value Raw meta value.
 * @return string[]
 */
function sanitize_meta( $value ) {
	if ( ! is_array( $value ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$ids = array_map(
		static function ( $id ) {
			return is_scalar( $id ) ? sanitize_key( (string) $id ) : '';
		},
		$value
	);

	return array_values( array_unique( array_filter( $ids ) ) );
}

/**
 * Only users who can edit the post may change its checklist state.
 *
 * @param bool   $allowed  Whether the user can edit the meta. Unused.
 * @param string $meta_key Meta key. Unused.
 * @param int    $post_id  Post ID.
 * @return bool
 */
function auth_meta( $allowed, $meta_key, $post_id ) { // phpcs:ignore Generic.CodeAnalysis.UnusedFunctionParameter.FoundBeforeLastUsed
	return current_user_can( 'edit_post', (int) $post_id );
}

<?php
/**
 * REST API endpoint for checklist item definitions.
 *
 * @package EditorialChecklist
 */

namespace EditorialChecklist;

use WP_REST_Server;

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Registers GET /editorial-checklist/v1/items.
 */
function register_routes() {
	register_rest_route(
		'editorial-checklist/v1',
		'/items',
		array(
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'callback'            => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\rest_get_items',
				'permission_callback' => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\rest_permissions_check',
			),
			'schema' => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\rest_get_schema',
		)
	);
}
add_action( 'rest_api_init', __NAMESPACE__ . '\\register_routes' );

/**
 * Permission check: the user must be able to edit posts.
 *
 * @return true|\WP_Error
 */
function rest_permissions_check() {
	if ( current_user_can( 'edit_posts' ) ) {
		return true;
	}

	return new \WP_Error(
		'rest_forbidden',
		__( 'Sorry, you are not allowed to view the editorial checklist.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
		array( 'status' => rest_authorization_required_code() )
	);
}

/**
 * Returns the checklist items.
 *
 * @return \WP_REST_Response
 */
function rest_get_items() {
	return rest_ensure_response( get_items() );
}

/**
 * JSON schema for the endpoint response.
 *
 * @return array
 */
function rest_get_schema() {
	return array(
		'$schema' => 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#',
		'title'   => 'editorial-checklist-items',
		'type'    => 'array',
		'items'   => array(
			'type'       => 'object',
			'properties' => array(

	if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_posts' ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$screen = function_exists( 'get_current_screen' ) ? get_current_screen() : null;

	if ( ! $screen || ! in_array( $screen->post_type, get_post_types(), true ) ) {
		return;

	$asset_file = EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_DIR . 'build/index.asset.php';

	if ( ! file_exists( $asset_file ) ) {
		return;

	$asset = include $asset_file;

	wp_enqueue_script(
		'editorial-checklist-editor',
		EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_URL . 'build/index.js',
		$asset['dependencies'],
		$asset['version'],
		true
	);

	wp_set_script_translations(
		'editorial-checklist-editor',
		'editorial-checklist',
		EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_DIR . 'languages'

			'editorial-checklist-editor',
			EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_URL . 'build/index.css',
			array( 'wp-components' ),
			$asset['version']
		);
	}
}

=== Editorial Checklist ===
Contributors: editorialchecklist
Tags: editorial, checklist, publishing, block editor
Requires at least: 6.6
Tested up to: 6.9
Requires PHP: 7.4

Adds a pre-publish editorial checklist to the block editor.

== Description ==

* Sidebar with checkboxes and a progress bar.
* Pre-publish panel that lists incomplete required items.
* Saving and publishing are locked while required items are incomplete.
* Each post's done-state is stored in the `_editorial_checklist` post meta.

= Filters =

`editorial_checklist_items` — change the checklist items:

    add_filter( 'editorial_checklist_items', function ( $items ) {
        $items[] = array(
            'id'       => 'seo',
            'label'    => 'SEO title and description set',
            'required' => true,
        );
        return $items;
    } );

`editorial_checklist_post_types` — post types that get the checklist (default: `post`, `page`). Post types must be shown in REST and support `custom-fields`.

== Development ==

    npm install
    npm run build

I've written the Editorial Checklist plugin to `./output/editorial-checklist/`. Nothing has been installed, built or run, so none of it is tested yet.

**Files written:**
- `editorial-checklist.php`: main plugin file (header, constants, includes)
- `includes/items.php`: default checklist items, the `editorial_checklist_items` filter that cleans up and de-duplicates items, and an extra `editorial_checklist_post_types` filter
- `includes/meta.php`: registers the `_editorial_checklist` post meta with an array schema, a sanitize callback and an `auth_callback` that checks `edit_post`
- `includes/rest.php`: the `GET editorial-checklist/v1/items` endpoint, restricted to users with `edit_posts`
- `includes/assets.php`: loads the editor script, styles and translations only on enabled post types
- `src/index.js`: registers the sidebar, its menu item and the pre-publish panel (imported from `@wordpress/editor`)
- `src/store/index.js`, `constants.js`, `reducer.js`, `actions.js`, `selectors.js`, `resolvers.js`: the `editorial-checklist/store` data store, which loads items from the endpoint with `apiFetch`
- `src/hooks/use-checklist.js`: keeps the store and post meta in sync through `useEntityProp`
- `src/components/checklist-sync.js`: loads saved state from meta, calls `lockPostSaving` / `unlockPostSaving` and shows or removes the `core/notices` warning
- `src/components/checklist-sidebar.js`: the sidebar with checkboxes, progress bar and a reset button
- `src/components/pre-publish-panel.js`: the pre-publish panel listing incomplete required items
- `src/editor.scss`, `package.json` (uses `@wordpress/scripts`), `readme.txt`

**Things to know:**
- **Requires WordPress 6.6 or later.** That's the version where `PluginSidebar` and `PluginPrePublishPanel` moved to `@wordpress/editor`.
- **Drafts can't be saved while required items are incomplete.** `lockPostSaving` blocks every save, not just publishing. Checkbox changes are saved with the post once the lock lifts.
- **Only `post` and `page` get the checklist by default.** Other post types can be added with the `editorial_checklist_post_types` filter, but they must be shown in the REST API and support `custom-fields`. Without those, the editor can't read or write the meta.
- **The lock only works in the block editor.** The server doesn't check the checklist, so someone can still publish through the REST API or another editor.

- `includes/assets.php`: loads the editor script, styles and translations only on enabled post types
- `src/index.js`: registers the sidebar, its menu item and the pre-publish panel (imported from `@wordpress/editor`)
- `src/store/index.js`, `constants.js`, `reducer.js`, `actions.js`, `selectors.js`, `resolvers.js`: the `editorial-checklist/store` data store, which loads items from the endpoint with `apiFetch`
- `src/hooks/use-checklist.js`: keeps the store and post meta in sync through `useEntityProp`
- `src/components/checklist-sync.js`: loads saved state from meta, calls `lockPostSaving` / `unlockPostSaving` and shows or removes the `core/notices` warning
- `src/components/checklist-sidebar.js`: the sidebar with checkboxes, progress bar and a reset button
- `src/components/pre-publish-panel.js`: the pre-publish panel listing incomplete required items
- `src/editor.scss`, `package.json` (uses `@wordpress/scripts`), `readme.txt`

**Things to know:**
- **Requires WordPress 6.6 or later.** That's the version where `PluginSidebar` and `PluginPrePublishPanel` moved to `@wordpress/editor`.
- **Drafts can't be saved while required items are incomplete.** `lockPostSaving` blocks every save, not just publishing. Checkbox changes are saved with the post once the lock lifts.
- **Only `post` and `page` get the checklist by default.** Other post types can be added with the `editorial_checklist_post_types` filter, but they must be shown in the REST API and support `custom-fields`. Without those, the editor can't read or write the meta.
- **The lock only works in the block editor.** The server doesn't check the checklist, so someone can still publish through the REST API or another editor.
